settings.editor: Blood pressure, heart rhythm and prevention, for adults of every age. Most tests are done here, on the day of your appointment.

settings.title: Tests we do in the building

settings.description_text: A ten-minute recording of the heart's rhythm, read by the doctor straight away.
A small recorder worn at home for a day, for symptoms that come and go.
A painless scan that shows how the heart and its valves are working.
An ECG on a treadmill, to see how the heart copes with effort.
